selection: Retain the original GPU-trained MSE network for lower January RMSE than the MAE-focused alternatives. The CPU MSE control had slightly lower January RMSE but worse 2025 validation MAE; no change selected using January. RMSE is an aggregate measure, not a guarantee against extreme errors.
capabilities: 48 consecutive hourly inputs, one turbine per request, CPU inference
limitations: Fixed-offset weather archive does not establish exact historical forecast issue availability
